name: remote access restore

priority.meaning: Editorial action order, not acceptance probability

variants.instruction: Two grey double-door tool cabinets stand on the table, doors facing -X (toward the arms): cabinet A on the -Y side and cabinet B on the +Y side. Each cabinet has two hinged doors with a round knob near the top of each door and a box with a front grab tab behind each door. Two identical paddle handles sit on the side face of the cabinet that faces the middle of the table, a front paddle and a rear paddle. The rear paddle of the -Y cabinet is near the left arm's reach; approach it at paddle height from the front. Left and right are as seen when facing the doors. Robot: two Panda arms with parallel grippers side by side, both facing +X (left base at x -0.40, y -0.42; right base at x -0.32, y 0.30); the left arm reaches the cabinet on the -Y side, the right arm the cabinet on the +Y side. Grippers point straight down and turn about vertical only. Tool workspace for this bench: X -0.20 to 0.45 m, Y -0.75 to 0.65 m, Z 0.82 to 1.40 m (the cabinets are 0.50 m tall). Joint torque limits 80 N m on joints 1-4, 12 N m on joints 5-7; each finger squeezes with at most 40 N; the arm force guard can be set up to 60 N; a wrist force above 80 N for 0.1 s aborts the episode. Goal: open the right door of cabinet A and put the box behind it on the table. A box counts as on the table when it rests upright on the table top outside the cabinet with no hand touching it. The final state must hold for 20 s after the hands let go. Damage ends success: a door must not hit the cabinet frame faster than 0.25 m/s measured at its knob, and a wrist force above 80 N held for 0.1 s counts as damage too.
variants.test_obligation: Retain source goal and all listed settings as regression cases even when submission-blocked. A new Robocurve implementation must be independently checked; archived acceptance is provenance only.

packaging_scope: Independent development folder with local scene/support/assets/runtime and pinned dependencies. Not submission-ready: missing reviewed scoring/agent evaluation/media and task packaging evidence.

robot.description: Native two-Panda arms with source-specific Franka/Robotiq2F85 hands. Inspect actual native build metadata for actuator count and gripper model. YAM/Dream conversion is optional.
robot.agent_route_status: Requires verified agent SDK/Inspect Robots adapter for selected embodiment. Privileged source reference replay alone is not agent evaluation.

scoring.current: Original binary source success with native runtime damage/terminal handling; no invented partial credit
scoring.remaining: Use each box placed or each door externally verified stage2 locked and retained after pull/hold. Stage1 flush-looking closure, slam and overload need explicit zero-credit behavior.

fidelity: Source estimates/simplifications must be disclosed. Physical setup and external numeric scoring must be reproducible; new hardware calibration is optional unless required to substantiate the particular fidelity claim.

remaining_evidence.fidelity: Disclose fidelity, estimated parameters and simplifications, and provide a reproducible physical setup with numeric externally measurable scoring. Prefer supporting specs or calibration when the claimed fidelity requires them; an actual hardware measurement/calibration campaign is not a universal prerequisite or an extra approval step.
remaining_evidence.scoring: Define a standalone numeric scorer with physical measurement proxies, exact sampling/hold/terminal rules, all outcome branches and reset protocol. Preserve damage vetoes; never expose private simulator state to the policy.
remaining_evidence.robot: Declare the robot and hands used by the task, preserve their actual reach/actuator/force limits and provide a working agent SDK route plus a successful demo in that embodiment. Native dual-Panda and source-specific Franka/Robotiq2F85 hands are valid development/submission choices. For robots other than two parallel-gripper arms, official instructions use an LLM through Inspect Robots rather than Dream-1. YAM/Dream compatibility is required only if that route is selected.
remaining_evidence.partial_credit: Source success is Boolean on every bench. Design and validate observable stages or continuous error bands, explicit weights and a global invalidation rule; demonstrate incomplete and damage/exploit negatives before allowing any nonzero credit.
remaining_evidence.evidence: Fresh board/task-detail and relevant benchmark overlap review; reproducible setup, standalone numeric scorer, declared embodiment and working agent SDK/Inspect route, successful full-score demo within the justified limit, and required evaluation/media under the selected official route. Hardware calibration beyond the stated fidelity claim is optional evidence.
remaining_evidence.mechanism_and_measurement: Suggested fidelity evidence / external scoring proxies, not mandatory new hardware tests: Document physical cable/paddle routing and release travel; externally test each door retained under a specified pull, film slam speed and box rest/door closure.
remaining_evidence.robot_specific: Declare and validate the native source embodiment, working agent interface, robot demo and episode limits. Retain actual source hands and motion requirements. Optional YAM conversion notes only: Demonstrate YAM simultaneous paddle/door access and safe door return; source guards above30N may be needed.
remaining_evidence.partial_credit_specific: Use each box placed or each door externally verified stage2 locked and retained after pull/hold. Stage1 flush-looking closure, slam and overload need explicit zero-credit behavior.

separation_rationale: One mechanism/outcome family. Parameters, height, load, object identity/colour/count, starting scene and transfer setting stay test variants; no further submission split is supported by this inventory.
boundary: No PR, upload, model call, paid job, task.json media or claimed score is created by this wrapper. Board-blocked variants remain testable, not eligible for submission.
package_evidence: No isolated package reference run claimed. Source/runtime fingerprints allow later comparison with matching evidence.
